name: Calling Wind
body:
School transmutation [air]; Level druid 5, shaman 5

Casting Time 10 minutes

Components V, S

Range 10 miles/level

Target up to 10 creatures/level

Duration instantaneous

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

You can send a message or sound on the wind to a specific set of creatures you designate. You need not know the identity of the target, but you must know some important information like position, description, or location. For example, you could send a message to any members of the druid circle that are within the forest.

The wind cannot pass through walls, but if there are windows, it will attempt to pass through. The summoning wind is only discernible as a gentle breeze by those except the recipients. The message can be a single sound for which you are familiar or a message of up to 25 words.

This spell cannot be used to speak verbal components, command words, or otherwise activate magic items or effects.
